verdict.rationale: Firstbase's pricing page documents a mail service with "Unlimited incoming mail, scans" and "Unlimited digital storage," plus in-app file digitization, so scanned mail does land in an online account. Nothing shows that registered-agent state mail and legal notices go through this scanning flow, and nothing shows reading, downloading or sharing those documents in the app. Missing for 10: explicit scanning of state/legal registered-agent documents, documented read/download/share capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, state mail and legal documents are scanned into an online account where I can read, download, and share them
